function.description: A question or conversational request directed at the assistant that no other tool handles: facts, explanations, advice, chit-chat, quotes.

function.name: stop
function.description: Stop whatever the assistant is currently doing: speaking, playing media, an active timer or alarm sound.

function.name: unsupported
function.description: A command clearly directed at the assistant that none of the other tools can perform. The assistant will say it can't do that.

function.name: ignore
function.description: The speech was NOT directed at the assistant: background conversation, TV or radio, the assistant hearing its own voice, or noise. The assistant stays silent.
